command:
set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/mail-filter-routing
deliver=$base/bin/deliver
"$deliver" < "$base/samples/accounts.eml"
"$deliver" < "$base/samples/support.eml"
"$deliver" < "$base/samples/general.eml"
"$deliver" < "$base/samples/general.eml"

printf '%s\n' 'delivery verification:'
for box in accounts support general; do
    expected=$base/samples/$box.eml
    count=0
    for delivered in "$base/Maildir/$box/new/"*; do
        [ -f "$delivered" ] || continue
        count=$((count + 1))
        cmp -s "$expected" "$delivered"
        printf 'box=%s file=%s bytes=%s sha256=%s byte_identical=yes\n' "$box" "${delivered##*/}" "$(wc -c < "$delivered")" "$(sha256sum "$delivered" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
    done
    case "$box" in
        general) [ "$count" -eq 2 ] ;;
        *) [ "$count" -eq 1 ] ;;
    esac
    printf 'box=%s count=%s expected_count_ok=yes\n' "$box" "$count"
done
printf '%s\n' 'staged samples after delivery:'
for sample in "$base"/samples/*.eml; do
    printf 'sample=%s bytes=%s sha256=%s\n' "${sample##*/}" "$(wc -c < "$sample")" "$(sha256sum "$sample" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
done
printf 'subject_header_instances='; grep -h -i '^Subject:' "$base"/Maildir/*/new/* | wc -l
printf 'delivered_file_count='; find "$base/Maildir" -path '*/new/*' -type f | wc -l
